audience.text: Python developers building 3D content pipelines, CAD tools, 3D-printing workflows, and visualization applications who need a dependency-free, cross-platform 3D processing library.

capabilities.text: Imports OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, COLLADA, and 3MF files via Scene.open() with automatic format detection from file extension or explicit FileFormat.
capabilities.title: Load multiple 3D formats

capabilities.text: Exports scenes to OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, and 3MF using Scene.save() with format-specific options for coordinate flipping, unit scaling, and compression.
capabilities.title: Export to common 3D formats

capabilities.text: Build meshes from control points and polygons using Mesh.control_points and Mesh.create_polygon(), or convert primitives via to_mesh().
capabilities.title: Construct and edit meshes

capabilities.text: Attach LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, or PbrMaterial to nodes and configure color and factor properties for diffuse, specular, albedo, metallic, and roughness.
capabilities.title: Assign materials and lighting

capabilities.text: Build hierarchical scenes using Node.create_child_node(), access transforms via Node.transform, and manage entities and materials per node.
capabilities.title: Traverse and manipulate scene graphs

capabilities.text: Create animation clips with AnimationClip, AnimationNode, and KeyframeSequence for time-based transformations.
capabilities.title: Support keyframe animation

limitations.text: FBX export is not implemented; FbxExporter.save() and save_to_stream() raise NotImplementedError.
COLLADA export is not reachable through Scene.save() due to exporter lookup order issues.
Scene.render() and the entire aspose.threed.render module raise NotImplementedError.
Texture construction raises NotImplementedError; image-backed textures cannot be created.
Mesh boolean operations (union, difference, intersect) raise NotImplementedError.
NURBS curve evaluation and surface-to-mesh conversion raise NotImplementedError.

problems_solved.text: Enables reading and writing common 3D exchange formats—OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, COLLADA, and 3MF—through a unified Scene/Node/Mesh object graph.
Supports building 3D geometry from scratch using parameterized primitives like Box, Sphere, and Cylinder, and converting them to editable meshes.
Provides material assignment and PBR support for realistic rendering of 3D assets in glTF workflows.
Offers polygon triangulation and mesh editing capabilities for preparing geometry for 3D printing and other downstream processes.

product_summary.text: Aspose.3D FOSS for Python is a pure-Python, MIT-licensed library for loading, constructing, and exporting 3D scenes without native dependencies.

uncertainties: The exact set of formats supported beyond the documented ones (OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, COLLADA, 3MF, FBX) is not fully specified; other formats may be partially implemented but not reachable.
Whether the experimental FBX importer works reliably with real-world FBX files is uncertain due to lack of integration tests with actual FBX fixtures.
The behavior of Scene.save() when no format can be inferred (e.g., saving to a stream without filename or explicit FileFormat) is only documented in examples, not guaranteed by API.
The status of less frequently used primitives (e.g., Torus, Pyramid, Dish) beyond their existence as public symbols is not verified by examples.

workflows.name: Import and inspect 3D scenes
workflows.text: Load OBJ, STL, glTF, COLLADA, or 3MF files using Scene.open() and inspect nodes, meshes, and materials.

workflows.name: Export scenes to exchange formats
workflows.text: Write scenes to OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, or 3MF using Scene.save() with format-specific SaveOptions for fine-grained control.

workflows.name: Build scenes programmatically
workflows.text: Construct a scene graph using Scene, Node, and Mesh classes, attach entities and materials, and position nodes with transforms.

workflows.name: Triangulate arbitrary polygons
workflows.text: Convert complex polygonal faces into triangle fans using PolygonModifier.triangulate() for compatibility with downstream tools.

workflows.name: Assign materials to geometry
workflows.text: Attach LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, or PbrMaterial to nodes and configure diffuse, specular, albedo, metallic, and roughness properties.

workflows.name: Export to 3MF for 3D printing
workflows.text: Generate 3MF files suitable for 3D-printing workflows using ThreeMfSaveOptions with optional compression control.
